meta.title: dsh-plugin-toolkit
meta.description: DeepSeek Harness personal toolkit: small runtime-toggleable quality-of-life optimizations, each shipped as one card in the Toolkit settings page. Optimizations: workspaceless chat, edit-and-resend last message, activity grouping in the sidebar, Chinese slash-menu descriptions, a per-turn change report, the OpenCode Go per-conversation session header, model-capability sync for an llm-pi-ai route, and a ghost-text suggested reply in the composer (Tab to fill).
